caption: The drawing depicts a single standing female figure facing forward. She has light skin, blue eyes, and dark hair styled in curls, and she is wearing a pink bonnet tied under her chin. The figure wears a dark patterned jacket with wide sleeves and dark cuffs and collar over a high-necked dress that has a red and white checkered pattern. The dress is voluminous, with a ruffled hem and an underskirt that appears to be pinkish with a subtle pattern. Her hands are clasped together in front of her and covered by light-colored gloves. She is also wearing pink boots with laces or decorative features. The background is plain and undecorated, and the overall composition centers the figure on the page.
title: Doll: "Flora Richardson"
